id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Your work was admirable, Hendrik, and you too, {var:1}.
"Seeing your strength, I am sure. Now is the time to strike and bring light back to this land.
"Infiltrate Heliodor Castle, now a den of monsters, and slay the one who brings eternal night. I entrust this to you.
"Hear me out. I am not without a plan. I had the castle secretly scouted for some way to strike back.
"My spies found a path atop the cliffs of Heliodor hill that leads to the underground waterways and into the castle.
"That is the only way in. This key unlocks the gate to the sewers. {var:1}, I entrust it to you.
"Sire, I object! Who will command the fortress in the meantime!?
"If they attack while we are gone, this place will be a monster feeding ground!
"That is what we will use. While monsters assail this place, the castle will be lightly guarded.
"Now we must destroy the monster in Heliodor Castle who brings eternal night. Then the morning will return!
"But I... I cannot afford to lose any more of my people!
"That is exactly why I ask this of you. There is no one else.
"If night alone continues, people's hearts will be lost too.
"Do not worry. These past months I have learned how strong, kind, and brave my people are.
"Just one night. If we hold on one night, victory is ours. I shall defend the fortress.
"I leave it to you. You are our hope.
By the King's arrangement, {var:1} took a short rest. Then the time to depart came...!
